card.name: Inside syringe and injectable product names
card.fires_on: Partway through words naming injection devices or dosage forms, such as autoinject-or, sy-ringe and inject-able, in dosing and preparation sections. It also fires on a few nearby spots like a number inside a concentration or the gap before a vial strength.

modes.label: Injection device words
modes.description: The first piece of syringe, autoinjector or injectable before the word is completed.

modes.label: Dosage form phrases
modes.description: Words in a product form phrase such as for oral suspension or powder for oral solution.

modes.label: Concentration and vial numbers
modes.description: A digit or space inside a concentration range or vial strength in preparation steps.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward finishing the word or phrase, and away from words like ready, predefined or existing.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of words like syringe, autoinjector and injectable when a label describes how a drug is supplied and prepared.
